ns2:section.sectionText: The course covers management of tradable financial risks in the context of financial institutions which incur these risks through their operations, product offerings, assets, and liabilities. We examine the methods used by practitioners to measure and manage interest rate, equity, credit, and other market risks using derivatives such as futures, swaps, and options. Curriculum is challenging, hands-on, and practical to prepare students for professional roles in global and capital markets.
